summary.what_it_does:
This Wikipedia article defines social networking services and explains how they differ from online community services, which are group-centered. It covers the history of social networking sites from early services like Usenet, BBS, and GeoCities through Friendster, MySpace, and Facebook. It classifies services into four types: socialization, online social networks, networking, and social navigation. It also discusses social impact, including research on news use, loneliness, mental health, and business and science uses.</what_it_does>
